svg.title: Dr. Enosh A Paulson - profile
svg.desc: Terminal-style profile card. Left: dotted halftone portrait. Right: Dr. Enosh A Paulson, Building ai for a healthier tomorrow. Dentist turned healthcare AI and medical informatics enthusiast, exploring how AI can solve real-world healthcare problems. Role: Healthcare AI | Medical Informatics | AI & Data Science; Education: PGDMI, AI & Data Science in Healthcare | IIHMR Bangalore; Additional Education: Online MBA in Healthcare Management | Manipal; Focus: Clinical AI, Hospital AI Implementation, Machine Learning, Digital Health, Clinical Decision Support; Interests: Healthcare Data Science, Medical Imaging, Predictive Analytics, LLMs, Health-Tech Product Development; Currently: Learning, building prototypes, exploring healthcare AI opportunities, and developing practical technical skills.
